title: Dominus Gladiatus
summary: A brutal gladiator management simulator. Recruit, train and equip gladiators and make life or death decisions throughout a deadly tournament against rival Domini.
description: Take control of a gladiator school in ancient Rome. Recruit fighters from the slave markets, expand your Ludus with new facilities, and manage morale, injuries and fatigue as you decide who rests and who fights. Arm every gladiator for their role, then watch your choices play out in brutal auto-battler duels and team battles, where one mistake can cost a life.

title: Dark Quest 4
tagline: Assemble your party. Conquer the dungeon.
summary: A turn based dungeon crawler where you create a party of heroes to go on epic quests.
description: Dark Quest returns with a turn-based strategy adventure inspired by the legendary HeroQuest board game. The evil Gulak, the Dark Sorcerer's puppet, sends monstrous legions to steal villagers in the night, and only your band of champions can end his reign. Embark on 30 handcrafted quests through multi-floored dungeons, outsmart over 40 unique monsters and survive deadly traps with magic and steel.

Command up to 10 unique heroes, train them in the Hero Camp and unlock new cards and abilities to forge your perfect team. Team up online or in local couch co-op for up to 3 players, then step into Creator Mode to build your own dungeons and quests and share them with players around the world.

title: Blow it up
summary: A physics destruction game. Unlock new bombs, explore the world and go on an epic journey of destruction.
description: Blow it up is a physics destruction game with light puzzle elements: aim your bombs at the right spot and watch the towers your enemies hide behind come crashing down. Aliens have invaded BOOMTOPIA, stripped it of its resources and captured your friends one by one. Now it's time to fight back and rescue them.

Master 7 unique bombs across more than 70 levels of mayhem, in an advanced physics simulation where every block behaves naturally, with TNT, confetti and fireworks for extra spectacle. Build your own levels in Creator Mode and play creations from other players through Steamworks.

title: Monarchy
summary: A 2D side-scrolling strategy game of resource management, base defense and conquest.
description: Monarchy is a 2D side-scrolling strategy game where you build a base, manage resources, explore a mysterious forest and conquer your enemies. Place buildings anywhere with a dynamic building system, hunt wild animals with your archer, and lead an army that follows you and fights automatically.

Search the forest caves for treasure and surprises, set spear traps to guard your base, and use the cart and the monolith to balance each run with unique upgrades. Clear out bandits in summer, besiege a castle with a mighty trebuchet in autumn and survive the secrets of winter, on your own or together with friends and family.

title: Geometry Survivor
summary: A rogue-lite auto shooter where you must survive for 20 minutes against waves of geometry ships.
description: Geometry Survivor is a rogue-lite auto shooter where you must survive for 20 minutes against waves of geometry ships. Your weapons fire automatically and you steer with just one hand, so all your focus goes on staying alive and breaking their formations.

Every run gives you a new combination of weapons, and the credits you earn permanently unlock new upgrades. With a multitude of enemies, each with their own AI, and retro visuals and music straight from the 80s, it's 20 minutes of intense survival.

title: Dark Quest 3
tagline: A new evil has risen in the East.
summary: A rogue-lite tabletop that mixes card based exploration with turn based combat.
description: A power-hungry sorcerer of chaos magic is laying siege to the realm, and the Elder has called on heroes like you. Dark Quest 3 is a rogue-lite tabletop adventure: create your party at the hero camp, choose your path across the world, draw adventure cards and roll the dice in tactical turn-based combat on the road to the chaos castle.

Choose from 12 heroes, face over 60 monsters across 13 areas and more than 150 adventure cards, and arm your party with 80+ combat cards of spells, weapons, potions and equipment. Procedurally generated adventures, the skull of fate and a fully voiced sorcerer playing Dungeon Master make every run a new tale, until you win or die.

title: Story of a Gladiator
tagline: Find your destiny in the sands of the colosseum.
summary: An arena beat 'em up where you take the role of a man in search of his destiny, only to find it in the sands of the colosseum.
description: You are a common man who has lost everything to the Roman empire: your family, your friends, your home and your land. Having escaped slavery, you roam the streets of Rome wondering why the gods spared you, until fate finally reveals itself in the sands of the colosseum.

Inspired by classic beat 'em ups like Streets of Rage, Double Dragon and Golden Axe, Story of a Gladiator throws you into 36 battles across 3 arenas against over 80 gladiators, 20 animals and 3 bosses. Learn new moves, win the crowd, pray to the gods, train your own tiger and choose your origin from Greece, Carthage or Egypt. Die with honor!

title: Dark Quest 2
logline: A dice-driven dungeon RPG inspired by HeroQuest
summary: A turn based RPG inspired by the legendary board game HeroQuest, with a hand-drawn isometric art style and dice based combat.
description: Dark Quest 2 is a turn-based RPG inspired by the legendary board game HeroQuest, with a party of heroes, hand-drawn isometric art and dice-based combat. Every map takes you deeper into the castle in search of the evil sorcerer's chambers, testing your party's strength, courage and sanity along the way.

Each hero takes one action per turn, so play wisely, and when all hope is lost, roll the skull of fate. Between quests, visit the village to learn new powers from the old masters, craft weapons and mix potions. Play the story campaign alone or cooperatively with friends, and create your own adventures with the map editor.

title: Dark Quest
logline: The turn-based dungeon crawler that started the saga
summary: A turn based dungeon crawler where you command a party of heroes on an epic quest to defeat the dark sorcerer. Now remastered for consoles.
description: The original Dark Quest, fully remastered. A powerful sorcerer has built a dungeon beneath the village of Darkwood, and his minions raid the nearby villages, spreading terror and death. A small band of heroes, led by a mighty barbarian, dares to defy him and descend into the dungeon.

Lead a party of up to 3 heroes, each with unique abilities, and work together against endless hordes of orcs and undead. Spend the gold you find on new potions, weapons and spells in the village, and when the sorcerer summons you to the sphere of judgment, roll the skull of fate and face your twisted fate.
